title: Coherent-State Propagation: A Computational Framework for Simulating Bosonic Quantum Systems
summary: We introduce coherent-state propagation, a computational framework for simulating bosonic systems. We focus on bosonic circuits composed of displaced linear optics augmented by Kerr nonlinearities, a universal model of bosonic quantum computation that is also physically motivated by driven Bose-Hubbard dynamics. The method works in the Schrödinger picture representing the evolving state as a sparse superposition of coherent states.
